def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    patches = image_patch.find("peach")
    lines = group_lines(patches, "left")
    if len(lines) < 1:
        return None
    seq = order_from(lines[0], "top")
    return seq[3] if len(seq) >= 4 else None
